title: User Account
notes: Administrative transitions shown are representative. Application authorization still applies. Status changes invalidate existing sessions.

title: Authentication Session
notes: These are derived session conditions, not a database status enum. Logging in again creates a new session.

title: Shopping Cart
notes: A converted or abandoned cart is not reactivated; further shopping uses a new active cart.

title: Sales Order
notes: FULFILLMENT is a visual group, not a stored status. Farmer cancellation is allowed only while PENDING_CONFIRMATION. Payments and refunds remain separate lifecycles.

title: Payment
notes: Expired payOS links map to FAILED in the current PayOsPaymentService. Invalid or duplicate webhooks do not create a second receipt of money. Retrying a failed or cancelled payment creates a new Payment.

title: Delivery
notes: OPEN_DELIVERY is a visual group. Delivery has no PARTIALLY_CANCELLED status: after partial delivery, cancelling the remainder ends the Delivery as DELIVERED; cancelled quantities stay on its items.

title: Delivery Attempt
notes: Only one attempt may be IN_PROGRESS for a Delivery at a time. Another attempt is a new object.

title: Delivery Incident
notes: Inventory consequences, when applicable, require an appropriate posted stock movement.

title: Goods Receipt
notes: Only draft receipts are editable or cancellable. Confirmed receipt corrections require a separate adjustment or reversal operation.

title: Inventory Lot
notes: Representative business transitions. DEPLETED is a declared status, not a claim that current stock-posting code changes status automatically at zero stock. Actual expiry date is checked independently; expired, quarantined, blocked or depleted lots cannot be sold/reserved/allocated.

title: Stock Movement
notes: STOCK_IN, SALE, RETURN_IN and ADJUSTMENT are movement types, not lifecycle states. POSTED remains eligible for reversal, so it is not connected directly to final.

title: Stocktake
notes: Completion requires all active items to be counted; stale lines must be handled according to the snapshot rules.

title: Inventory Reservation
notes: Statuses are derived from reserved, consumed and released quantities. After any consumption, release the unused remainder instead of cancelling the reservation.

title: Credit Reservation
notes: CONSUMED means some amount was consumed and no reservation remains; unused amounts may have been released. Credit exposure includes receivables plus active remaining reservations.

title: Farmer Credit Profile
notes: Available credit = credit limit - outstanding receivables - remaining reserved credit. ACTIVE alone is insufficient: customer, debt account and other eligibility rules also apply.

title: Debt Account
notes: Administrative status changes are shown. The Domain status setter does not make CLOSED irreversible; authorization and business restrictions belong to the use case.

title: Debt Entry
notes: OPEN_DEBT is a visual group. A disputed entry may receive payments and stays DISPUTED until resolved. Overdue is derived from due date and balance, not an enum state. Receivable changes require DebtTransactions.

title: Sales Return
notes: Only resellable goods may be restocked. Reduce attributable unpaid debt first, then refund the remaining eligible value. Only REQUESTED return items are editable.

title: Refund
notes: Applies to sales-return and cancelled-order refunds. A failed refund is retried with a new Refund, never by reopening the failed object.

title: AI Diagnosis Case
notes: Review requires can_review_ai. VERIFIED and INCONCLUSIVE allow re-review and are not final states. A new review supersedes the previous review and deactivates its recommendations. Recommendations require VERIFIED; Healthy cases receive treatment guidance only, no product recommendation.

title: AI Model
notes: A retired model version is not reactivated by the current Domain lifecycle.

title: AI Policy Config
notes: Inference requires an active policy of the selected active model, effective at inference time. Policies never bypass mandatory Human Review for recommendations.

title: Product
notes: Representative administrative transitions. Product, StoreProduct, packaging, prices and eligible inventory jointly determine sellability. DISCONTINUED is not enforced as an irreversible terminal state by the Domain setter.

title: Price List
notes: Actual price applicability also requires valid effective dates and customer-group assignments.

title: Article
notes: The current design allows moving articles to draft, publishing and archiving without imposing an irreversible final state.

title: Contact Request
notes: This is the usual handling flow, not an exhaustive transition restriction. The design does not impose a fixed state graph; resolving records resolved_at.

title: Notification
notes: Reading records read_at. Archiving is a semantic lifecycle operation, not physical deletion.

title: Notification Outbox
notes: Operational conditions derived from ProcessedAt, AvailableAt and attempt count, not a stored status enum. Retries use increasing delays.

title: Payment Allocation
notes: An ORDER allocation cannot be reversed once prepayment has been consumed. ORDER_PAYMENT permits ORDER allocations; DEBT_REPAYMENT permits DEBT allocations.

title: Debt Transaction
notes: Posted financial history is preserved; reversal is a semantic operation with corresponding ledger effects, never physical deletion.
